entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A knight and orator of the Sun Empire who discovers her planeswalker spark while fighting Angrath and is sent to find Orazca to earn the title of warrior-poet.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: Huatli's cousin and fellow knight, a healer with medicinal magic, who aids and teases her.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli III
entities.description: The ambitious emperor of the Sun Empire who trusts Huatli and charges her to find the golden city of Orazca.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A bull-headed, chain-wielding planeswalker pirate who kills Huatli's dinosaur, seeks the Immortal Sun and recognizes Huatli as another planeswalker.

entities.name: Wayta
entities.description: A thirteen-year-old girl who admires Huatli and whom Huatli advises to write honest poetry.

entities.name: Teyeuh
entities.description: A fellow knight whom Inti proposes to bring on the expedition.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire of Ixalan's Sun Coast, ruled from Pachatupa by an emperor, which is expanding its control.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire invaders of the Sun Coast whom Huatli's squadron has repelled.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A band of pirates of human, ogre and goblin crew whose ship appears off the coast.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: A rival people who once controlled the continent and who are thought to know the way to Orazca.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: A legendary lost golden city that Huatli glimpses in her vision and is sent to find.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A powerful artifact said to lie within Orazca, sought by many including Angrath.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: The Sun Empire's amber-colored capital city, where the Temple of the Burning Sun stands.

entities.name: Temple of the Burning Sun
entities.description: The great temple in Pachatupa from which the emperor addresses the citizens.

entities.name: Sun Coast
entities.description: The eastern coast where the Sun Empire fights invaders.

entities.name: Kinjalli
entities.description: A deity invoked in Huatli's oration.

entities.name: Tilonalli
entities.description: A deity invoked in Huatli's oration to fill children's hearts with fire.

events.summary: Huatli and Inti return to Pachatupa with a captured Legion of Dusk sword after a final victory on the Sun Coast.
events.quote: Huatli and Inti were returning from the Sun Empire's last major campaign on the Sun Coast.

events.summary: Huatli advises the young Wayta that poetry should be honest rather than merely good.
At the homecoming ceremony Huatli rides before the crowd, presents the sword to Emperor Apatzec and delivers an oration.
events.quote: Huatli turned and presented the Legion of Dusk sword to the crowd below.

events.summary: The emperor announces the next stage of expansion to reclaim the south but does not yet name Huatli warrior-poet.
events.quote: we are ready to reclaim the south,

events.summary: Apatzec privately tells Huatli she will not fight in the south but will guard the eastern coast against a possible Brazen Coalition and Legion attack.
events.quote: I am not sending you to fight in the south.

events.summary: A month later Huatli and Inti ride to a Brazen Coalition camp on the coast and burn its supplies.
events.quote: Sparks flew onto the dry wood of the crates, and almost instantly they caught flame.

events.summary: Angrath ambushes Huatli, kills her dinosaur with chains, and demands the location of the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: I am the dread pirate Angrath,

events.summary: Huatli fights Angrath and wounds him, but he overpowers her and Inti with his searing chains.
events.quote: she sliced a clean line across his chest with her blade.

events.summary: Huatli's planeswalker spark ignites; she glimpses a golden city before being pulled back, with the planeswalker sigil appearing above her.
events.quote: It was a city that shone with the warmth of gold.

events.summary: Angrath recognizes Huatli as another planeswalker and offers to help each other leave, but she wounds him and flees with Inti.
Huatli tells Inti she believes she saw Orazca.
Huatli tells Emperor Apatzec what she saw, and he declares it proof of her worthiness.
events.quote: What you saw is proof of your worthiness to hold that mantle.

events.summary: The emperor promises Huatli the title of warrior-poet if she finds the Golden City of Orazca, and she vows to retrieve the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: The title of warrior-poet is yours if you can locate the Golden City of Orazca.

events.summary: Inti offers to accompany Huatli with Teyeuh, and Huatli admits she wants to find the city.
events.quote: I want to find the city.

relations.quote: The two had grown up together

relations.note: his knight and most trusted tactical advisor
relations.quote: she had become his most trusted tactical advisor.
Apatzec Intli III was responsible not only for the new assertion of control

relations.note: killed her mount and tried to kill her
relations.quote: how dare he think I would ever help him after he killed my dinosaur and tried to kill me
The Legion of Dusk had retreated to their ships without weapons or pride.
she shined brighter than any other knight in the Sun Empire.

relations.note: the Immortal Sun is said to lie within Orazca
relations.quote: retrieve the Immortal Sun inside for the glory of the Sun Empire.
